shortDescription: MEXICO CITY, Sept 25 (Reuters) - Mexico's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate was 2.7 percent in August, the national statistics agency said on Friday.The headline unadjusted rate was 3.0 percent in August.((Mexico City newsroom, +52 55 5282-7153, mexicocity.newsroom@reuters.com))

children: MEXICO CITY, Sept 25 (Reuters) - Mexico's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate was 2.7 percent in August, the national statistics agency said on Friday.
